customManagers.description: actionlint's release tag and tarball SHA-256 in validate-workflows.yml; Renovate takes the same asset's hash from the new release.
Bundled libraries released on npm; vendor-sync.yml copies the new files in.
Bundled libraries taken from an upstream branch; Renovate moves the commit, vendor-sync.yml copies the new files in.

packageRules.description: beta takes only the bundled libraries; everything else updates main and reaches beta in the merge after each stable release.
Bundled libraries ship in the plugin, so their updates go to beta for testing, never straight to main.
See above: main never takes a bundled-library update.
Bundled libraries ship to users, so their updates are fix(deps).
One PR for the non-major bundled updates. The preset automerges minor and patch but not digests, so an upstream-branch commit is merged by hand.
A new npm release waits 7 days before it is bundled; a hijacked publish is normally pulled within that.
chartjs-plugin-streaming 2.0.0, its last release, needs chart.js 3 (peer ^3.0.0).
